messages:
Dana (marketing): Quick ask for the launch blog + webinar: we need an auditable bench bundle (fp16 + int8) with gen + embed p50/p95, cold vs warmed profiles, and a one-paragraph public runbook. Can you take this?

Theo (eng-runtime): Yes. Two clarifying items: (1) token distribution? (2) desired percentiles?

Dana (marketing): Mostly short (<=64) with ~12% long (>1024). Please include p50/p90/p95 for gen and p50/p90 for embeds. Also include a 10% randomized holdout and record the RNG seed in the manifest.

bench-bot: queued job 8342 1 ingesting payloads from drive:/marketing/launch/benchpack_v3.jsonl

Priya (eng-runtime): We'll run on staging dedicated nodes, batch=1 for slide numbers, warmup=0 and warmup=6 variants. Deliverables: runs/*.csv (per-request), summary.csv (requested percentiles + pass/fail), manifest.txt (holdout seed), runbook.md (one paragraph + example command), traces.tar.gz, artifacts.zip. ETA: Tuesday 11:00 PST.

Dana (marketing): ETA works. For public-friendly KPIs, can you include pass/fail flags against: gen median <= 300ms (<=64 tokens) and embed p50 <= 35ms? Mark FAILs explicitly.

Theo (eng-runtime): We'll add pass/fail in the summary. Also we'll capture kernel version for int8 and whether KV-cache was used. If p95 variance is high (>35% over p50) we'll do a labeled rerun and keep both artifact sets.

Dana (marketing): Please do not cherry-pick. We'll verify the holdout manifest with SRE before publishing.

bench-bot: job 8342 -> ingest complete: 50 payloads detected, artifacts staged at /artifacts/8342

Priya (eng-runtime): Smoke started. Short CSV excerpt: 

```
req,variant,warmup,total_ms,model_ms,tokens
A001,fp16,false,420,405,48
A002,int8,true,195,180,28
A003,fp16,false,1255,1240,1400
```

Dana (marketing): Great. Once artifacts.zip is uploaded, ping #marketing and paste a 1-line checklist: artifacts present, manifest with seed, slide-ready summary, runbook included. We'll then slot numbers into the deck pending SRE holdout check. Thanks! :thumbsup:
